newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol to make key European acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Endemol to make key European acquisition.

text.p: Endemol NV, already one of Europe's top two TV production companies, said on Thursday it would announce the acquisition of a television production firm in a major European country in the next few months.

Chief financial officer Aat Schouwenaar told Reuters in an interview that Endemol was already one of the top players in its field in the Netherlands, Germany and Spain and was keen to obtain a similar status in Britain, Italy and France.
"We will be making an announcement about an acquisition in at least one of those three countries," he said.
